commands:
for chain in $(echo 'INPUT' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do for proto in $(echo 'tcp' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do
<iptables> -D $chain -p $proto --dport ssh -j f2b-a
done; done
<iptables> -F f2b-a
<iptables> -X f2b-a

for chain in $(echo 'INPUT' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do for proto in $(echo 'tcp' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do
<iptables> -C $chain -p $proto --dport ssh -j f2b-a
done; done

for chain in $(echo 'INPUT' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do for proto in $(echo 'tcp' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do
<iptables> -D $chain -p $proto -m multiport --dports ssh -j f2b-b
done; done
<iptables> -F f2b-b
<iptables> -X f2b-b

for chain in $(echo 'INPUT' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do for proto in $(echo 'tcp' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do
<iptables> -C $chain -p $proto -m multiport --dports ssh -j f2b-b
done; done

nft add table inet f2b-table
nft -- add chain inet f2b-table f2b-chain \{ type filter hook input priority -1 \; \}
nft add set inet f2b-table <addr_set> \{ type <addr_type>\;<sp>flags interval\; \}
if [ 'tcp' != "all" ]; then
for proto in $(echo 'tcp' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do
nft add rule inet f2b-table f2b-chain $proto dport \{ $(echo 'http,https' | sed s/:/-/g) \} <addr_family> saddr @<addr_set> reject
done
else
nft add rule inet f2b-table f2b-chain th dport \{ $(echo 'http,https' | sed s/:/-/g) \} <addr_family> saddr @<addr_set> reject
fi

{ nft flush set inet f2b-table <addr_set> 2> /dev/null; } || {
{ nft -a list chain inet f2b-table f2b-chain | sed -nE 's/.*@<addr_set>\s+.*\s+\#\s*(handle\s+[0-9]+)$/\1/p'; } | while read -r hdl; do
nft delete rule inet f2b-table f2b-chain $hdl; done
nft delete set inet f2b-table <addr_set>
nft add set inet f2b-table <addr_set> \{ type <addr_type>\;<sp>flags interval\; \}
if [ 'tcp' != "all" ]; then
for proto in $(echo 'tcp' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do
nft add rule inet f2b-table f2b-chain $proto dport \{ $(echo 'http,https' | sed s/:/-/g) \} <addr_family> saddr @<addr_set> reject
done
else
nft add rule inet f2b-table f2b-chain th dport \{ $(echo 'http,https' | sed s/:/-/g) \} <addr_family> saddr @<addr_set> reject
fi
}
nft list chain inet f2b-table f2b-chain | grep -q '@<addr_set>[ \t]'

^\s*(?:\[\]\s*)?\[vaultwarden::api::(?:identity|admin|core::two_factor::authenticator)?\]\[ERROR\] (?:Invalid admin token|Invalid TOTP code|Username or password is incorrect)[\.!](?:\s+(?!IP:)\S+)* IP: <ADDR>(?:\. Username: <F-USER>\S+</F-USER>)?

files.jail.local:
[apache-nohome]
enabled = true
backend = polling
logpath = /dev/null tail
bantime = -1
action = iptables[name=a]
           iptables-multiport[name=b, port=ssh]
[vaultwarden]
enabled = true
backend = pyinotify
logpath = /dev/null tail
bantime = 1y
findtime = 3600
action = 
filter = %(__name__)s[mode=more]
port = ssh
usedns = raw
[nginx-forbidden]
enabled = true
maxretry = 0
findtime = 1d
filter = %(__name__)s[mode=errors]
ignoreip = example.com

stderr:
